title: okf-strategy — status history sidecar (OKF-Strategy profile v1.0)
description: The sidecar data/<object>-<objectId>-status.json referenced by cps.status.statusResource (SPEC §4.3.1). One entry per period that has a status, a percent complete, or narrative, oldest first. Not a concept — it has no frontmatter and no `type`.

concept.description: Concept ID of the owning element. Back-reference to the concept whose cps.status.statusResource points here.

periodicity.description: The element's reporting periodicity, as in cps.periodicity.

period.description: Period name as the source shows it.

periodDate.description: Last day of the period. Orders the list.

updatedBy.description: Name of who entered this period's status.
